message.content:
Sure! To determine your friend’s MBTI type, I’ll need the percentage representation of each personality trait. Could you please provide an array of objects like this:

```json
[
  {"trait": "Extraversion", "percentage": 70},
  {"trait": "Introversion", "percentage": 30},
  {"trait": "Sensing", "percentage": 60},
  {"trait": "Intuition", "percentage": 40},
  {"trait": "Thinking", "percentage": 55},
  {"trait": "Feeling", "percentage": 45},
  {"trait": "Judging", "percentage": 65},
  {"trait": "Perceiving", "percentage": 35}
]
```

Feel free to adjust the percentages to match your friend’s actual scores. Once you provide the data, I’ll evaluate it and give you the MBTI type.
